key_insight: Exact distance certification reveals when quantum error-correcting codes and circuits provide less protection than assumed and verifies improvements from redesigned schedules.
engineering_relevance: Certified distances can guide circuit scheduling and defective-chip acceptance, improving reliability assessments and estimated usable hardware yield.
method: Express code and circuit distances as tropical partition functions.
Evaluate using rank-based dynamic programming and weight-bounded search, aided by reductions and relaxations.
Certify exact values by matching proved lower bounds with explicit logical errors of equal weight.
evidence_signal: The method certified distances for codes up to 31,200 qubits and circuits up to 800,000 fault mechanisms; an audit found overestimated distances or non-tight upper bounds in 10 of 26 papers.
watch_item: Schedule improvements may add execution overhead: restoring IBM two-gross circuit distance from 16 to 18 at one noisy cycle required one extra timestep per cycle.
paper_title: Certifying quantum code and circuit distances at scale
